description: There is a 4 x 5 cm homogeneous enhancing intra-axial lesion in the left cerebellum, showing restricted diffusion, heterogeneous signal on T2W sequences, hypointense to grey matter on T1W sequences and hyperintense to grey matter on FLAIR sequences.
